_meta.validation_note: Every expected_intent value is a member of IntentEnum; every expected_next_action is a member of NextActionEnum (app/temporal/workflows/leadgen/models.py). All stop items pair intent=stop with next_action=close per . All has_site items pair intent=has_site with next_action=close per routing rule 3 in interpret_response_activity (has_site → close; corrected 2026-06-09 from send_D which was incorrect — hotels that already have a site should not trigger site-generation). 2026-06-15 (ADR-OUTREACH-008 influencer-pretext pivot): added SIM-042..049 covering the new first-reply reality — warm 'who recommended us?' curiosity is question→send_C (C answers generally, never names a source); a skeptical/hostile challenge to how we found them ('are you sure you have the right hotel?', 'who exactly recommended us, and when?') is unclear→escalate (route to a human, do not let C invent a checkable source); flattery never overrides has_site→close (SIM-047).

_schema.tier: optional — T1|T2|T3 personalization tier the opener used

cases.inbound_message: Hello! Yes, we would be very interested to know more about a website for our property. Please send us more details.
cases.notes: Clear eager interest, explicit request for more info — canonical interested case.

cases.inbound_message: Hi, thanks for reaching out. We actually don't have our own website so this sounds interesting. What would the process look like?
cases.notes: Interest plus embedded question; intent=interested because the hotel confirms no site and wants to proceed.

cases.inbound_message: Good morning. We have been thinking about getting a website. Tell me more please.
cases.notes: Warm, unprompted disclosure they have been considering it.

cases.inbound_message: Yes! We would love a proper website. We rely entirely on OTA right now and it is not ideal.
cases.notes: Mentions OTA dependency but frames it as a pain point and expresses desire for own site — intent=interested, not has_site.

cases.inbound_message: Sure, send me more information. We are open to hearing about this.
cases.notes: Polite but mild interest; not enthusiastic but clearly not negative.

cases.inbound_message: That sounds very promising. We have guests who always ask for our direct website for repeat reservations. Please go ahead.
cases.notes: Specific pain point (repeat-reservation guests) strengthens intent signal.

cases.inbound_message: We are interested. Can you also tell us about payment integration for direct reservations?
cases.notes: Contains a question but the primary signal is declared interest; question is downstream detail.

cases.inbound_message: My manager reviewed your message and we would like to proceed. Please explain what you need from our side.
cases.notes: Decision-maker involved; clear green-light.

cases.inbound_message: What is included in the free website offer exactly? Is there a catch?
cases.notes: Skeptical question about the offer; no commitment either way — needs qualifying answer.

cases.inbound_message: How long does it take to set up the website? And do we need to provide photos ourselves?
cases.notes: Two practical setup questions; implies interest but primary signal is informational.

cases.inbound_message: Who owns the website once it is built? Can we move it to our own hosting later?
cases.notes: Ownership/portability question — legitimate due diligence before committing.

cases.inbound_message: Is this free forever or only for a trial period? What happens after?
cases.notes: Pricing ambiguity question — needs honest answer before prospect can decide.

cases.inbound_message: Can the website support Vietnamese language? Most of our guests are domestic.
cases.notes: Localisation feature question; implied interest in the offer.

cases.inbound_message: Do you also help with SEO? We want people to find us on Google.
cases.notes: Feature question about SEO; positive framing — wanting discoverability.

cases.inbound_message: Will this work with our existing OTA account or does it replace it?
cases.notes: Integration question; common concern from OTA-dependent hotels — needs reassurance answer.

cases.inbound_message: We already have our own website, thank you. Please check sunsettresort.com
cases.notes: Explicit own-site declaration with URL — canonical has_site case. Routing rule 3: has_site → close (hotel already has a site; site-generation is not applicable).

cases.inbound_message: We have a website. It was made by a local agency two years ago.
cases.notes: Has-site without URL — close funnel. Routing rule 3: has_site → close.

cases.inbound_message: Yes we use OTA and also have our own site at hoanglong-hotel.example
cases.notes: Both OTA and own site — has_site → close. Routing rule 3: has_site → close.

cases.inbound_message: Our hotel website is already online. It is on WordPress.
cases.notes: Has site on WordPress — close funnel. Routing rule 3: has_site → close.

cases.inbound_message: Thanks but we already have a reservation platform integrated on our own domain.
cases.notes: Has own domain with reservation platform — close funnel. Routing rule 3: has_site → close.

cases.inbound_message: We have a page on our Facebook, does that count? We use that instead of a website.
cases.notes: A Facebook page is NOT a working direct-reservation website (guests cannot self-book there) — so this is the core lead, not has_site. interested → send_C (the free direct-reservation-page offer is exactly relevant here).

cases.inbound_message: We are not interested. Please do not message us again.
cases.notes: "Please do not message us again" is an explicit opt-out demand (no STOP keyword, but an unambiguous request to cease contact) → stop → close.

cases.inbound_message: We use only OTA and are happy with it. No need for a website.
cases.notes: Classic 'OTA only' objection with explicit satisfaction — not_interested.

cases.inbound_message: We rely on OTAs and have no budget or need for a separate website. Thank you.
cases.notes: Budget+need objection; polite but firm — not_interested.

cases.inbound_message: Not interested at this time.
cases.notes: Terse rejection; short reply — not_interested, close.

cases.inbound_message: We are a small family guesthouse and this is not relevant for us. Good luck.
cases.notes: Self-disqualification (size/relevance) — not_interested, close cleanly.

cases.inbound_message: Our owner has decided we will not pursue this. Thank you for your message.
cases.notes: Decision-maker explicit rejection; polite finality — not_interested, close.

cases.inbound_message: We tried a website before and it was a waste of money. Not interested.
cases.notes: Past negative experience; explicit rejection — not_interested.

cases.inbound_message: STOP
cases.notes: Bare STOP keyword — canonical opt-out. intent=stop AND next_action=close.

cases.inbound_message: Please stop messaging us immediately.
cases.notes: Explicit stop request in plain language — must be treated as opt-out. .

cases.inbound_message: Unsubscribe. Remove our number from your list.
cases.notes: Unsubscribe + list-removal demand — legal opt-out equivalent. .

cases.inbound_message: Do not contact us again. This is harassment.
cases.notes: Hostile opt-out with harassment claim — definitely stop+close, must not retry. .

cases.inbound_message: Arrêtez de m'envoyer des messages / Stop sending messages.
cases.notes: Bilingual (French+English) stop request — stop keyword present in English portion. .

cases.inbound_message: Ok
cases.notes: Single word with no interpretable signal — unclear, wait for follow-up.

cases.inbound_message: We will think about it.
cases.notes: Non-committal deferral — unclear, set wait to give time before follow-up nudge.

cases.inbound_message: Can you send me your brochure?
cases.notes: Request for brochure is off-script — agent cannot fulfil; escalate to human to handle.

cases.inbound_message: Hello, we are looking for a tour operator partner. Are you a travel agency?
cases.notes: Completely off-topic: prospect asking us if we're a tour operator — escalate, human needed.

cases.inbound_message: Sorry I pressed the wrong button. Ignore this.
cases.notes: Accidental reply; no intent signal — unclear, wait without acting.
Emoji-only reply with no decodable intent — unclear, wait.

cases.inbound_message: We are currently under renovation and will reopen in March. Maybe contact us then.
cases.notes: Temporary deferral with future intent signal — not a rejection. Ambiguous: is this interested (later) or not_interested (now)? Labelled unclear+wait as safest classification; human review appropriate at follow-up.

cases.inbound_message: Yes, please go ahead and build the website. We are ready to proceed.
cases.notes: Explicit green-light at qualifier stage — hotel has confirmed interest and no site; agent should proceed to site-reveal (send_D). Routing rule 7: at site-reveal stage with confirmed interest → send_D.

cases.inbound_message: Oh how kind! May I ask who recommended us?
cases.notes: pretext pivot: warm, curious 'who recommended us?' is a question (engaged) -> send_C. Agent C answers GENERALLY (a travel contact) and pivots to the offer; it must never name a specific source.

cases.inbound_message: Thank you so much, that means a lot. Which blog was it? We'd love to thank them!
cases.notes: Pretext pivot: warm request to name the blog. Still a question -> send_C. The danger case for C — it must stay general and not invent a checkable blog/influencer name.

cases.inbound_message: That's lovely to hear. We don't have our own website yet — what would you suggest?
cases.notes: Pretext pivot: flattered by the recommendation, confirms no site, asks to proceed -> interested -> send_C.

cases.inbound_message: We've never worked with any travel bloggers. Are you sure you have the right hotel?
cases.notes: Pretext pivot: pointed, skeptical challenge to how we found them. NOT a question to auto-answer (C would have to dig the pretext deeper) — route to a human -> escalate.

cases.inbound_message: Interesting — how did you hear about us?
cases.notes: Pretext pivot: neutral-curious 'how did you hear about us?' is an engaged question -> send_C (general answer + pivot to offer).

cases.inbound_message: Thank you for the kind words! We actually already have our own website though.
cases.notes: Pretext pivot: flattery must NOT override has_site. Hotel already has a site -> close (routing rule 2).

cases.inbound_message: Wow, thank you! That is so kind of them. Yes, we would love a website.
cases.notes: Pretext pivot: flattered + explicit interest at opener stage -> interested -> send_C (qualify before any site reveal).

cases.inbound_message: This sounds like a sales trick. Who exactly recommended us, and when?
cases.notes: Pretext pivot: hostile credibility challenge demanding a specific, checkable source — the failure mode the pretext most risks. Route to a human -> escalate; do not let C improvise a fake source.

cases.inbound_message: What dates were you looking at? We have good availability this month.
cases.notes: Classic customer-misread: hotel asks us for stay dates instead of answering the direct-reservation question. reservation_request -> send_C (Agent C deflects-and-requalifies). Never unclear/wait.

cases.inbound_message: We'd love to host you! When would you like to come and how many guests?
cases.notes: Warm reservation_request: hotel is enthusiastic but asking for reservation details. Strong core-lead signal (manual reservations, no own site) but question skipped — reservation_request/send_C.

cases.inbound_message: Just email us your dates and the number of guests and we'll sort it out directly.
cases.notes: Hotel offering to take reservations over email — reservation_request. No own direct-reservation site mentioned; manual channel = core lead. Route send_C to deflect and re-pose the qualifying question.

cases.inbound_message: chat the dates to +1 555 000 1234 and we'll confirm your reservation.
cases.notes: Hotel accepting reservations over chat — reservation_request. Manual channel with no own site. Agent C re-ask should reference chat as the channel when deflecting.

cases.inbound_message: How many rooms and which nights were you thinking? We can hold one for you.
cases.notes: Hotel offering to manually hold a room — reservation_request. Reveals manual reservation process. Never classify as unclear; send_C to deflect and re-qualify.

cases.inbound_message: Happy to take your reservation directly — just let us know the check-in date and how long you're staying.
cases.notes: Explicit manual direct reservation offer — reservation_request. 'Take your reservation directly' with no mention of own website reveals they mean manually (not via a reservation site). send_C.

cases.inbound_message: You're all set for the 5th to the 7th — see you then! We've noted the reservation.
cases.notes: Over-commit: hotel has written us in their book without us providing dates. Still reservation_request — they're responding AS IF we are a customer. Agent C must NOT accept/confirm dates; send_C to deflect warmly.

cases.inbound_message: What name should I put the reservation under? We'll hold it for you.
cases.notes: Hotel asking for guest name to complete a reservation — reservation_request. Manual reservation process with no own site signal. send_C to deflect and re-pose the qualifying question.

cases.inbound_message: We have our own website at hotelx.example and we're also listed on OTA.
cases.notes: Hotel has own domain AND OTA listing. has_site takes priority — close the funnel gracefully. Routing rule 2: has_site -> close.

cases.inbound_message: We use a channel manager and an agency for all our online reservations — they handle everything for us.
cases.notes: Hotel uses intermediaries (channel manager + agency) not their own direct-reservation site. No own site = core lead. interested/send_C — the free site offer is relevant.

cases.inbound_message: Auto-Reply: I am out of office until Monday. For urgent matters please contact reception@example.com. I will reply when I return.
cases.notes: Auto-reply OOO — no actionable signal. unclear/wait; do not trigger follow-up messaging until a real reply arrives.

cases.inbound_message: How did you get my email address? I never signed up for any mailing list or marketing contact.
cases.notes: Skeptical challenge to how we obtained their contact — pointed, needs a human. unclear/escalate; do not let Agent C improvise an explanation.

cases.inbound_message: We're on OTA mostly, but who actually recommended us to you, out of curiosity?
cases.notes: Warm curiosity about referral source plus implicit OTA signal. question/send_C — Agent C answers generally (travel contact who stayed) and pivots. Must never name a specific source.

cases.inbound_message: Please remove me from your mailing list. I don't want any more emails like this.
cases.notes: Explicit list-removal / opt-out request. stop/close per . 'remove me' matches the STOP keyword gate.

cases.inbound_message: Not for us, thanks.
cases.notes: Terse polite rejection. not_interested/close — no opt-out keyword, but clear declination.
